results.notes: All factual claims regarding the RBI's Master Directions, including the six-hour reporting window, the 12-hour cooling period, and compliance timelines for different categories of PSOs, are fully supported by the provided source texts.

results.headline: Food Safety Watchdog Seizes 3,280 Tonnes of Food Ahead of Festivals

issues.claim: Compared to last year's festive enforcement drive which audited roughly 35,000 facilities, this operation expanded inspection coverage by over 60%.
issues.detail: The source text does not mention the number of facilities audited in the previous year's festive drive or provide a comparison to previous years' coverage.

issues.claim: FSSAI announced the seizure of 3,280 tonnes of food items and 52 licence cancellations on Sunday.
issues.detail: The source text states the FSSAI made the announcement in a social media post on Saturday (November 7, 2026), not Sunday.
issues.correction: FSSAI announced the seizure of 3,280 tonnes of food items and 52 licence cancellations on Saturday.

results.notes: The story accurately reports the core figures from the source text but includes an unverifiable claim regarding historical inspection comparisons and incorrectly identifies the day of the announcement.
